time_model.headline: Estimated time - not measured on a robot
rules: Every time here is an ESTIMATE computed from the simulator's command list. Nothing was measured on a robot.
Aspirate / dispense: volume (µL, per channel) divided by the flow rate. The flow rate is the one the simulator printed for that command; if it printed none, default_flow_rate_ul_s is used.

Gantry travel: straight-line XY distance between consecutive pipette positions divided by gantry_speed_mm_s (constant speed; no acceleration, no Z travel, mount offset ignored). The first move starts from home_xy_mm.
Tip pick-up, tip drop, blow-out, touch-tip: fixed seconds (pick_up_tip_s, drop_tip_s, blow_out_s, touch_tip_s) on top of the travel time.
Delay: the exact number of seconds written in the protocol.
Temperature module set / wait: a placeholder (temperature_set_s, temperature_wait_s). The real time depends on the module and the temperature change.
Magnetic module engage / disengage, temperature deactivate, home: fixed placeholders (magnet_move_s, temperature_deactivate_s, home_s).
Pause: a HUMAN step. The robot waits for a person, so no duration is estimated and none is added to the total.

Comments, unrecognised commands and the headers of transfer / distribute / consolidate / mix take 0 s. Only their primitive steps (pick-up, aspirate, dispense, ...) carry time and volume, so nothing is counted twice.
